title: Vogue Elegance
objective: Generate a commerce landing page for bag.

admin.behavior: No public login entry is rendered. Admin inventory controls render only when localStorage has vogueEleganceAdmin=true or vogueEleganceUserEmail matching the allowed email.

dataNotes.shopBrand: The public storefront is branded as Vogue Elegance.
dataNotes.productSource: New-arrival product names, INR prices, compare-at prices, and sale or sold-out labels were checked from public Magnolia Bags new-arrivals pages on June 25, 2026.
dataNotes.imagery: Product photos are stored locally under src/generated/assets so the app does not request remote images at runtime.
dataNotes.map: The contact section links to the requested real Google Maps location and uses a local themed map illustration instead of a tracking iframe.
dataNotes.security: No credentials, tracking scripts, or backend calls are embedded.

fileOperations.reason: Render the Vogue Elegance storefront with separate new-arrival and regular product sections, contact icons, map location, and hidden admin-only controls.
Apply responsive premium storefront styling and themed map/card layouts.
Store brand, contact, product, material, and source data separately from the React page.
Store local product photos for self-contained rendering.
Document the generated app handoff and current orchestrator plan.
Record build metadata and orchestrator handoff details.
Remove obsolete generated page modules if present.
